guitar.modelsText: Ibanez / ESP / ESP LTD signature models
guitar.evidence: Gojira's Joe Duplantier and Christian Andreu are documented long-time ESP/Charvel and custom guitar users in modern metal press; not iconic to the level of a 'signature' single model but reasonably well documented gear.

tone.target: tight modern metal rhythm with articulate low end and dark high gain
tone.profile: tight modern metal rhythm with articulate low end and dark high gain
tone.summary: A high-gain signal chain utilizing a modern aggressive amp model (Recti) paired with a robust 4x12 cabinet, enhanced by compression and distortion for maximum tightness and articulation.

blocks.purpose: Eliminate hum and unwanted noise inherent in high-gain metal tones.
Increase sustain and even out the pick attack for tight palm-muting.

alternatives.reason: If compression is too much, a simple boost can provide necessary gain lift.

blocks.purpose: Provide aggressive, tight high gain without the muddy character of fuzz or vintage breakup.

alternatives.reason: Could work for aggression but might sound too mid-scooped compared to modern metal.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the aggressive, modern high-gain sound of a Mesa/5150 style amp.

alternatives.reason: A good alternative for aggressive rock, but Recti is closer to the target modern metal sound.

blocks.purpose: Provide a solid, punchy foundation for the rhythm tone.
blocks.gap: While 'UK Vintage 4x12' is used, the target requires a modern metal cabinet sound (like an Amener/Greenback style). This choice provides necessary size and clarity.

alternatives.reason: Could offer more punch, but UK Vintage is reliable for general high-gain use.

blocks.purpose: Enhance the low-end articulation and high-end clarity crucial for modern metal chugging.
Used sparingly for the occasional cleaner atmospheric break without heavy modulation.
blocks.gap: The Chorus is kept minimal and mostly off, fulfilling the 'occasional clean' requirement without adding distracting movement.

alternatives.reason: Too aggressive for this genre; chorus provides a more subtle wash.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle depth and space during atmospheric sections.
Provide a subtle sense of space for the atmospheric parts.

improvements.summary: Upgrade the cabinet simulation to better match modern, aggressive metal tones.

proposals.reason: Better captures the punch and clarity needed for tight modern metal chugging.
